facts.fact: 双体船本该无法从马哈吉尔憩地脱身。
facts.anchor: It should have been impossible for the catamaran to flee Mahagir’s Rest.

facts.fact: 不久船便挣脱狂风，全速越过越海。
facts.anchor: Before long the vessel had torn itself free of the gale and was speeding over the Eversea

facts.fact: 他本可选择不与奥莉尔·费拉赛合谋，用自家附魔师配制的血清封掉塔拉辛的以太术。
facts.anchor: He could have chosen not to conspire with Oryal Ferasai to nullify Talasyn’s aethermancy with a serum devised by his Enchanters.

facts.fact: 她心里有一个死去的季节在尖叫。
facts.anchor: There was a dead season screaming inside her.

facts.fact: 他们在米祖尔最庞大的浮空堡垒、旗舰尤兰特号上。
facts.anchor: We are onboard the flagship Iurant, greatest of the Midzuli floating fortresses

facts.fact: 一旦萨多维亚人与盟军撞进残余凯萨斯风暴舰的正面火力。
facts.anchor: Once the Sardovians and their allies sailed into the teeth of the remaining Kesathese stormships

facts.fact: 她无法低头向乌尔杜佳·西利姆——杀害她母亲的人——乞求援兵。
facts.anchor: She couldn’t bear to face Urduja Silim—her mother’s murderer—with a bowed head and pleas for aid.

facts.fact: 紫色魔法的烟柱从瓦西亚斯岛最高峰阿克塔马索克涌出，巴昆正沉睡其下。
facts.anchor: plumes of violet magic wafted out from Aktamasok, the highest peak on the island of Vasiyas, beneath which Bakun lay sleeping
